business.product_description: Onsite hospital specialized only in Gynaecology and Pediatrics — offers the full range of related services, from surgeries to medicines.
business.usp: Fully specialized end-to-end Gynae + Pediatric care (surgeries, medicines, and everything in between), unlike general hospitals in the area.

history.previous_spend: PKR 10,880 on a prior awareness campaign (912K impressions, 701K reach, 0.25% CTR, 6 link clicks, doctor-branded creative: Dr. Bushra Rauft / Dr. Rifayat Ullah), run 2026-08-25 to 2026-09-05 then paused. A WhatsApp-click campaign is live now (started 2026-09-07, PKR 292 spent so far).
history.what_worked: Doctor-branded creative got strong reach; WhatsApp-click format is a natural CTA for a hospital.
history.what_failed: The awareness campaign was optimized for reach, not lead generation — 912K impressions produced only 6 link clicks and zero measurable conversions (no pixel, no CAPI).
